correctness.rationale: Exhaustive enumeration covers all \(2^{15}=32768\) labeled tournaments and partitions them into 56 \(S_6\)-orbits. For every canonical representative, the published out-neighborhood-complex definition is reconstructed exactly. An explicit discrete-Morse matching is checked acyclic on the complete Hasse diagram and has no critical cell above dimension \(1\), with exactly one critical vertex per connected component. The archived 56-row census replays at the level of scientific data, and the unique \(\beta_1=4\) class is independently recovered from its orbit.

evidence: Theorem 4.12 gives vanishing of reduced homology in dimensions at least \(2\) for six-vertex simple digraphs. Proposition 5.1 constructs sphere-valued tournament examples at sharp odd orders.
broader_coverage.reasoning: These results constrain possible six-vertex topology but do not determine \(H_0\), \(H_1\), exact homotopy-type counts, or the unique \(\beta_1=4\) extremizer, so they do not imply the claim.
